title: the big fart
description: This modpack is a fun, silly and enchancing modpack which adds on to the already exisitng ever evolving vanilla experience. adds shaders, mobs, biomes etc.
body:
This modpack is definetly unique to some of the other mod packs out there. maintly made to play with friends, it gives the expereince of vanilla minecraft and doubles it with more ores, more mobs, completely different biome generation, optimization mods. it is noted that this modpack is not for the weak computers and is generally seen to be compatible with more mid tier to high end computers because of the amount of sheer mods that it has. some mods that this modpack includes adding herobrine into the game, more general ores and more varients of zombies. mods that the modpack includes are:
